name: get_patient_analytics
description: Get 12-month patient health trend analytics: blood pressure, BMI, HbA1c, weight, and LDL trends with targets, status, trend direction, and clinical insights.

name: get_population_health_metrics
description: Get population-level health metrics for the practice panel: chronic disease prevalence, HEDIS quality measure performance vs targets and national averages, utilization metrics, and improvement opportunities.

name: get_readmission_risk
description: Predict 30-day hospital readmission risk for a patient using clinical factors, social determinants, and utilization history (LACE+ enhanced model). Returns risk score, contributing factors, and intervention recommendations.

name: get_care_gap_analysis
description: Identify gaps in preventive care for a patient: overdue screenings, vaccinations, and wellness checks against evidence-based guidelines, with HEDIS quality measure impact and recommended actions.
